summary: C68 corrected the earlier post-phase-four cuss-gate mismatch. The first current divergence is the missing whole wizard.c:cuss behavior at segment 0 step 134: the lawful Archon enters the angel_cuss pager, whose shuffle and quote draws and output are absent in JavaScript. Port the whole cuss function; account for its consumed priest.c:mon_aligntyp return through is_lminion. questpgr.c:com_pager remains a discarded-void pager dependency whose side effects are still required for parity.

source.branch: Port all of cuss(): the Deaf early return; the iswiz speech and random branches; the non-wizard is_lminion && !renegade angel_cuss pager branch; the remaining minion-probability ancestry line or demon_cuss pager branch; and wake_nearto(mtmp->mx, mtmp->my, 25). In the assigned trace, the Archon passes the cuss gate and takes the lawful-minion branch. is_lminion consumes priest.c:mon_aligntyp(mon) == A_LAWFUL. The cuss-to-com_pager call is void and its result is discarded; the pager output and RNG remain a separately noted residual until questpgr.c:com_pager handles angel_cuss.

evidence: At challenges/evaluations/20261003220302-v21.json on examined commit feaa7dfc03eb5830327f077c97dade2dc161e61a, the assigned case has 134/138 screens, 2741/2820 RNG calls, and 138/138 cursors matched. The first residual is segment 0, step 134, key '.', screen cell row 0 column 0 (C '"', JS 'I'); RNG index 2726 is C rn2(3)=2 from nhlib.lua:random -> shuffle, while JS next draws rn2(5)=4 at dochug(monmove.c:992).

The saved C recording at step 134 records the successful post-phase-four cuss gate rn2(5)=0 @ dochug(monmove.c:992), followed by the pager's shuffle draws rn2(3)=2 and rn2(2)=0, then rn2(14)=0 @ com_pager_core(questpgr.c:566). The C screen starts the angel_cuss quote; JavaScript reaches a later dochug gate and displays 'I'. This establishes the immediate missing behavior as the cuss body and its pager side effects, after the gate fixed by C68.

The complete upstream owner is wizard.c:cuss (844-883): return immediately when Deaf; choose wizard-specific speech for iswiz; otherwise choose the lawful-minion branch when is_lminion and not a renegade; otherwise use the minion-dependent probability for ancestry speech or demon_cuss; then call wake_nearto with radius 25. This case reaches the is_lminion branch and calls com_pager("angel_cuss").

The consumed-return dependency is priest.c:mon_aligntyp (280-289): include/monst.h:is_lminion (281-282) evaluates is_minion(mon->data) && mon_aligntyp(mon) == A_LAWFUL. The helper selects priest alignment, minion extension alignment, or species alignment, preserves A_NONE, then normalizes sign to lawful, chaotic, or neutral. The JavaScript helper is present in js/priest.js:117.

questpgr.c:com_pager (623-627) returns void and explicitly discards com_pager_core's result; wizard.c:cuss also discards the wrapper call's result. Keep this pager path as an unported discarded-void residual (note_unported('questpgr.c com_pager') if skipped by a cuss port). Its quote output and RNG side effects remain necessary for strict parity; current js/questpgr.js:443 only implements portal message IDs.

The C caller is allmain.c:moveloop_core -> mon.c:movemon -> mon.c:movemon_singlemon -> monmove.c:dochugw -> monmove.c:dochug -> wizard.c:cuss. The current JavaScript caller reaches js/monmove.js:dochug through js/allmain.js and js/mon.js; after the C68 gate's rn2(5) succeeds, it records note_unported('wizard.c cuss') at js/monmove.js:2765-2776.
